title: command messages use raw user-supplied ids
description: pebbles delete echoes the raw user-typed ID argument, and the approve-on-non-proposed error prints the full UUID, while creation messages use the spec-canonical appropriate-length ID (r[appropriate-length-id]). Acceptance: all command output messages display the appropriate-length ID resolved from the index, never the raw argument or full UUID. Test: jj_integration t16 asserts delete echoes the canonical short id and the approve error does not contain the full UUID.
